ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45% high-intensity white pixels to 55% low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity central region extending from the peduncle to the median notch. The lateral lobes exhibit high-frequency, non-contiguous mottling (speckling). The right lobe contains a large contiguous high-intensity white patch in the mid-to-distal region, while the left lobe shows a more dispersed pixel distribution with white patches concentrated towards the tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 102 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the entire visible boundary; frequency increases towards the distal tips. Notable high-amplitude indentations (valleys) are present on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep trajectory along the trailing edge leading into the notch, with convex curvature on the outer distal margins.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity circular pixel groups (barnacle scars) are visible on the distal tip of the right lobe and scattered along the leading edge of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct, single dark linear disruption is oriented horizontally within the white patch of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent horizontal dark scar on the right lobe; irregular, ragged topography on the distal tip of the right lobe suggesting minor physical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive high-density 'salt-and-pepper' mottling pattern localized primarily in the upper quadrant of the left lobe.
